name: underline-link
title: Underline Link
description: A link with an animated underline in five styles, including a hand drawn scribble. Shows on hover, on keyboard focus, and for the current page.

props.name: href
props.description: Link target. Schemes other than http, https, mailto, and tel are replaced with #.

props.name: variant
props.description: grow-center grows from the middle, slide grows from and returns to the left, comes-in-goes-out enters from the left and leaves to the right, goes-out-comes-in is visible at rest and redraws itself, scribble draws a hand drawn stroke.

props.name: active
props.description: Mark the link as the current page with aria-current="page" and keep the line visible.

a11y: A native a element; the line and scribble are decorative and aria-hidden.
The line also appears on keyboard focus, next to a visible focus outline.
active sets aria-current="page", so the current page is announced, not only drawn.
With reduced motion, the line appears without a transition.

ai.whenToUse: Navbar, footer, and inline article links that need a clear, designed hover and focus state.
rules: The line uses the text color; set the color on the link
Use active for the current page in a navbar
Use scribble sparingly, for one or two emphasized links
No JavaScript; Blade does not need Alpine.js

id.description: Link dengan garis bawah beranimasi dalam lima gaya, termasuk coretan tangan. Tampil saat hover, saat fokus keyboard, dan untuk halaman aktif.

props.href: Tujuan link. Skema selain http, https, mailto, dan tel diganti #.
props.variant: grow-center tumbuh dari tengah, slide tumbuh dari dan kembali ke kiri, comes-in-goes-out masuk dari kiri dan keluar ke kanan, goes-out-comes-in tampil saat diam lalu menggambar ulang, scribble menggambar coretan tangan.
props.active: Tandai link sebagai halaman aktif dengan aria-current="page" dan garis tetap tampil.

a11y: Elemen a native; garis dan coretan bersifat dekoratif dan memakai aria-hidden.
Garis juga muncul saat fokus keyboard, berdampingan dengan outline fokus yang terlihat.
active memasang aria-current="page" sehingga halaman aktif diumumkan, bukan hanya digambar.
Dengan reduced motion, garis muncul tanpa transisi.

ai.whenToUse: Link navbar, footer, dan artikel yang butuh keadaan hover dan fokus yang jelas dan dirancang.
rules: Garis memakai warna teks; atur warna pada link
Pakai active untuk halaman aktif di navbar
Pakai scribble secukupnya, untuk satu atau dua link yang ditonjolkan
Tanpa JavaScript; Blade tidak butuh Alpine.js
